A plugin is a directory with manifest.json in the Omarchy Quattro schema; shell/Core/PluginLogic.js is the one judge of a manifest and a second validator is a twin. A plugin declares surfaces (kinds), never dependencies; a manifest with a requires key is refused by design. A plugin imports qs.Commons, qs.Ui, Qt and Quickshell modules other than Quickshell.Wayland, and its own files; it names no window type and no other plugin. A core action reaches a plugin only through a capability named in the manifest's vgs block. A new plugin lands with its row in scripts/qml-smoke.sh.
